\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{خدمات} (khadamât)}{خدمات (khadamât)}]{\fa{خدمات} (khadamât) — services}

\label{lesson:FA-C443-khadamat}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for to take back, then the Persian for to give back.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{خدمات}}
\textbf{\fa{خدمات}} (\emph{khadamât}) — \textquotedblleft{}services\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{خدمات} \fa{این} \fa{هتل} \fa{خیلی} \fa{خوب} \fa{است}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Khadamât-e in hotel kheyli khub ast.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
This hotel's services are very good.
\end{quote}

An Arabic plural of \emph{khedmat} 'service'.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{khadamât} is the Arabic plural of \emph{khedmat} 'service', which EtymDB takes from Arabic \emph{ḫidma} 'service'. EtymDB does not list the plural.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{khadamât}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{khadamât}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{khadamât}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for to take back, then the Persian for to give back, then say \emph{khadamât} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{کیفیت} (keyfiyat)}{کیفیت (keyfiyat)}]{\fa{کیفیت} (keyfiyat) — quality}

\label{lesson:FA-C443-keyfiyat}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for to give back, then the Persian for services.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{کیفیت}}
\textbf{\fa{کیفیت}} (\emph{keyfiyat}) — \textquotedblleft{}quality\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{کیفیت} \fa{غذای} \fa{هتل} \fa{پایین} \fa{بود}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Keyfiyat-e ghazâ-ye hotel pâyin bud.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The quality of the hotel's food was poor.
\end{quote}

\emph{Bâ keyfiyat} — of good quality.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{keyfiyat} was borrowed from Arabic and is usually traced to Arabic \emph{kayfiyya} 'the how of a thing, its manner', built on \emph{kayfa} 'how', which EtymDB lists.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{keyfiyat}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{keyfiyat}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for to give back, then the Persian for services, then say \emph{keyfiyat} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{راضی} (râzi)}{راضی (râzi)}]{\fa{راضی} (râzi) — satisfied, pleased}

\label{lesson:FA-C443-razi}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for services, then the Persian for quality.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{راضی}}
\textbf{\fa{راضی}} (\emph{râzi}) — \textquotedblleft{}satisfied, pleased\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{ما} \fa{از} \fa{اتاق} \fa{و} \fa{صبحانه} \fa{راضی} \fa{بودیم}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Mâ az otâq va sobhâne râzi budim.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
We were pleased with the room and the breakfast.
\end{quote}

The cause takes \emph{az}. Note the letter \fa{ض}, said \emph{z}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{râzi} was borrowed from Arabic \emph{rāḍī} 'content, pleased' (EtymDB).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for services, then the Persian for quality, then say \emph{râzi} again

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{انعام} (an'âm)}{انعام (an'âm)}]{\fa{انعام} (an'âm) — a tip, a gratuity}

\label{lesson:FA-C443-anam}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for quality, then the Persian for satisfied.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{انعام}}
\textbf{\fa{انعام}} (\emph{an'âm}) — \textquotedblleft{}a tip, a gratuity\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{به} \fa{گارسون} \fa{انعام} \fa{دادیم}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Be gârson an'âm dâdim.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
We gave the waiter a tip.
\end{quote}

\emph{An'âm dâdan} — to tip.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{an'âm} was borrowed from Arabic \emph{inʿām} 'that which is bestowed or granted' (EtymDB); in Persian it means a reward, and today a tip.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{an'âm}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{an'âm}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{an'âm}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for quality, then the Persian for satisfied, then say \emph{an'âm} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{تشکر} \fa{کردن} (tashakkor kardan)}{تشکر کردن (tashakkor kardan)}]{\fa{تشکر} \fa{کردن} (tashakkor kardan) — to thank}

\label{lesson:FA-C443-tashakkor-kardan}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for satisfied, then the Persian for a tip.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{تشکر} \fa{کردن}}
\textbf{\fa{تشکر} \fa{کردن}} (\emph{tashakkor kardan}) — \textquotedblleft{}to thank\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{از} \fa{راننده} \fa{تاکسی} \fa{تشکر} \fa{کردیم} \fa{و} \fa{پیاده} \fa{شدیم}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Az rânande-ye tâksi tashakkor kardim va piyâde shodim.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
We thanked the taxi driver and got out.
\end{quote}

The person thanked takes \emph{az}. Everyday thanks is \emph{mamnun} or \emph{merci}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{tashakkor kardan} is built from \emph{tashakkor} 'thanks', borrowed from Arabic \emph{tašakkur} (EtymDB), and \emph{kardan} 'to do', inherited from Middle Persian \emph{kardan} (EtymDB).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}

\raggedright

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{tashakkor kardan}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{tashakkor kardan}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for satisfied, then the Persian for a tip, then say \emph{tashakkor kardan} again
\end{itemize}

\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 436–443 — a review}

\label{lesson:FA-R443-review-436-443}



\begin{quote}
Say the Persian for a pier and a captain.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a pier, a captain, a deck, a dhow, to drop anchor
  \item a guesthouse, lodgings, a boarding house, a suite, to stay
  \item to receive, to settle the bill, an identity card, a deposit, a safe
  \item a bed sheet, a bedspread, an air conditioner, central heating, a view
  \item noise, dirty, to make a noise, smelly, a water heater
  \item to request, to look into, to find fault, to back down, dissatisfied
  \item to apologize, to make up for, to exchange, to take back, to give back
  \item services, quality, satisfied, a tip, to thank
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A pier? (\textbf{\fa{اسکله}}.) A captain? (\textbf{\fa{ناخدا}}.) A deck? (\textbf{\fa{عرشه}}.) A dhow? (\textbf{\fa{لنج}}.) To drop anchor? (\textbf{\fa{لنگر} \fa{انداختن}}.) A guesthouse? (\textbf{\fa{مسافرخانه}}.) Lodgings? (\textbf{\fa{اقامتگاه}}.) A boarding house? (\textbf{\fa{پانسیون}}.) A suite? (\textbf{\fa{سوئیت}}.) To stay? (\textbf{\fa{اقامت} \fa{کردن}}.) To receive? (\textbf{\fa{تحویل} \fa{گرفتن}}.) To settle the bill? (\textbf{\fa{تسویه} \fa{حساب} \fa{کردن}}.) An identity card? (\textbf{\fa{کارت} \fa{شناسایی}}.) A deposit? (\textbf{\fa{پیش} \fa{پرداخت}}.) A safe? (\textbf{\fa{گاوصندوق}}.) A bed sheet? (\textbf{\fa{ملافه}}.) A bedspread? (\textbf{\fa{روتختی}}.) An air conditioner? (\textbf{\fa{کولر}}.) Central heating? (\textbf{\fa{شوفاژ}}.) A view? (\textbf{\fa{منظره}}.) Noise? (\textbf{\fa{سر} \fa{و} \fa{صدا}}.) Dirty? (\textbf{\fa{کثیف}}.) To make a noise? (\textbf{\fa{صدا} \fa{دادن}}.) Smelly? (\textbf{\fa{بدبو}}.) A water heater? (\textbf{\fa{آب} \fa{گرمکن}}.) To request? (\textbf{\fa{درخواست} \fa{کردن}}.) To look into? (\textbf{\fa{رسیدگی} \fa{کردن}}.) To find fault? (\textbf{\fa{ایراد} \fa{گرفتن}}.) To back down? (\textbf{\fa{کوتاه} \fa{آمدن}}.) Dissatisfied? (\textbf{\fa{ناراضی}}.) To apologize? (\textbf{\fa{عذرخواهی} \fa{کردن}}.) To make up for? (\textbf{\fa{جبران} \fa{کردن}}.) To exchange? (\textbf{\fa{تعویض} \fa{کردن}}.) To take back? (\textbf{\fa{پس} \fa{گرفتن}}.) To give back? (\textbf{\fa{برگرداندن}}.) Services? (\textbf{\fa{خدمات}}.) Quality? (\textbf{\fa{کیفیت}}.) Satisfied? (\textbf{\fa{راضی}}.) A tip? (\textbf{\fa{انعام}}.) To thank? (\textbf{\fa{تشکر} \fa{کردن}}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
